extracted.name: Basic Sandwich Muffin (from All-purpose Baking Mix)
extracted.description: 6 net carbs Recipe from Wheat Belly Cook Book **Follow the recipe for All-purpose Baking Mix that I have to make these. **Another dense bread but flavor isn't too bad. VARIATION: Add 1/4 tsp each of dried rosemary and dried oregano
ingredient_lines: 1 T water + additional water if needed
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 4 cups of a muffin pan.
In a bowl, combine baking mix, baking powder and salt. Stir in oil thoroughly. Add egg and stir until mixed. If dough too stiff, add water 1 T at a time.
Divide dough into 4 muffin cups. Using spoon, flatten mounds until 1/2" thick, leaving shallow well in center.
Bake 12 min. or until edges begin to brown. Allow to cool 3 min. before carefully removing from pan.
